segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling Swift Deliveries. Can I have your tracking number please?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Sure, it is A B seven three nine two.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you. I can see the parcel is at your local depot. It will be delivered tomorrow before noon.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Great. Can the driver leave it with my neighbour if I am out?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, I have added that note to the delivery.
